title: Yellowed Spring Italian Leek Pasta
description: A savory and comforting Italian dish featuring leek, robata-grill, and raw-friendly ingredients, perfect for spring. This dish combines the sweetness of leeks with the heartiness of pasta.

ingredients.name: leeks
ingredients.notes: white and light green parts only

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
Meanwhile, preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat and brush the leeks with olive oil, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Grill the leeks for 5 minutes on each side, or until slightly charred and tender.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the grilled leeks to the skillet and stir to combine with the garlic and olive oil.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the leek mixture.
Stir in the grana padano cheese until melted and well combined.
Season with salt, black pepper, and lemon juice to taste.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
